title: Same distance at any frame rate
prompt: Simulate the robot frame by frame for the given number of seconds, at fps frames a second, and give back the distance covered. At 100 per second for 2 seconds the answer is 200 whether fps is 60 or 30.
starter:
func distance_at_fps(speed, seconds, fps) -> float:
	return 0.0
hints: delta is 1.0 divided by fps; each frame adds speed times delta to a total, and there are seconds times fps frames.
Loop seconds times fps times, adding speed times delta each turn.
`for i in range(seconds * fps):` with `total += speed * delta` inside.

docs.name: range(n)
docs.what: Gives the numbers 0 up to n - 1, for a for loop to count through.
